QuestInfo.name: Checking on the Temple of Time
QuestInfo.0: What could be important about the #m270000100#? Why did #p2159310# mention it? Investigate the place where the Black Mage was sealed.
QuestInfo.1: You entered the #m270000100#. Keep moving until you find something valuable. \r\nYou must complete the Temple of Time questline started by speaking to the Temple Keeper to complete this quest. If you use a teleport rock to complete the objective, the quest will not be completed.
QuestInfo.2: You ran into #p2159323# in the #m270000100#. When you refused #p2159323#'s urging to be a Commander once again, #p2159323# shouted at you and disappeared. Why was #p2159323# in the #m270000100#, anyway?

0.0: With my strength restored, I should return to the #m270000100# as #p2159310# mentioned. The #m270000100# is where the Black Mage is sealed, as well as his old stronghold. It is well worth investigating.

yes.0: Will I find anything important within the #m270000100#?

no.0: Since the strongest of the Black Mage's minions will be there, I could use a little more training first.

1.0: Something must have happened to Lotus, the other twin. What was #p2159323# doing here?

yes.0: She was speaking to the monsters. Hmm...
